title: What is in the room?
communication_goal: El estudiante puede decir qué hay en un espacio usando there is y there are.
situation: Describir una habitación a una persona que llega por primera vez.
language_focus: There are books on the shelf.

vocabulary.example: There are books on the shelf.

context.before: A host describes a guest room before someone arrives.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: There is a table and an armchair.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: Yes, there are two chairs near the window.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.text: Yes, there is. There are some books on it.

explanation_es: There is presenta una cosa: There is a table. There are presenta varias: There are two chairs. La expresión describe qué existe o se encuentra en un lugar; no es igual que usar there como ubicación.
spanish_speaker_notes: No digas There have para expresar hay; usa there is o there are.
Elige is o are según el sustantivo que aparece después, no según el lugar.
Con singular usamos a/an: There is a chair; con plural no usamos a/an: There are two chairs.

pronunciation.target: Distinguir there is y there are y producir la estructura con ritmo natural.
pronunciation.student_feedback: Haz audible la diferencia entre is y are, especialmente antes de la palabra importante.

reading.title: The guest room
reading.text: There is a small table in the guest room. There is an armchair next to the window. There are two chairs near the door. There are books on a shelf. The room is simple and comfortable.

questions.prompt: What is next to the window?
How many chairs are near the door?

activities.instruction: Clasifica qué objetos aparecen uno o varios.
activities.feedback_correct: Relacionaste la cantidad con is o are.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Uno = there is; más de uno = there are.

activities.instruction: Escucha y coloca el objeto en el mapa.
activities.prompt: There are two chairs near the door.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Busca two chairs y near the door.

activities.feedback_correct: Armchair es singular: There is an armchair.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Una cosa singular usa there is.

activities.correct_answer: There are books on the shelf.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Usa There are antes del sustantivo plural.

activities.feedback_correct: Para expresar existencia usamos there are.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Cambia have por are: There are two chairs.

activities.instruction: Describe tu habitación con una cosa y varias cosas.
activities.prompt: There is a ____. There are two ____.
activities.feedback_correct: La descripción distingue una cosa de varias.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Usa there is para uno y there are para dos o más.

activities.instruction: Lee el cuarto y completa un inventario de objetos y ubicaciones.
activities.feedback_correct: Usaste la lectura para construir el mapa de la habitación.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Busca table, armchair, chairs, books y sus ubicaciones.

activities.instruction: La IA llega a tu habitación. Descríbele qué hay y dónde está.
activities.student_goal: Use there is and there are to describe a room with locations.
activities.feedback_correct: Describiste un espacio de forma útil para un visitante.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Cuenta primero: singular = there is; plural = there are.

activities.instruction: Haz un tour de audio de tu espacio para una persona que llegará mañana.
activities.prompt: There is a ____. There are ____. The ____ is near ____.
activities.feedback_correct: Usaste there is/are para orientar a otra persona.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Incluye una cosa singular, varias cosas y dos ubicaciones.

activities.feedback_correct: Recuperaste there is y there are en contexto.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Uno = There is; varios = There are.

mastery_criteria.retry_policy: Los errores se programan para recuperación a 1, 3, 7 y 14 días.
